items.title: 6.5 Applications and Implications of Blockchain (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Blockchain maloomat mehfooz rakhta hai, aisi digital copy ki tarah jise sab dekh sakte magar koi badal nahi sakta. Yeh hissa is ke istemal dekhta hai: products ki nigrani, maali khidmat aur data ki hifazat.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein blockchain ke teen istemal bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Products ke maakhaz ki nigrani, maali khidmat, aur data ki hifazat.

items: Blockchain ke istemal: product tracking, maaliyat, data ki hifazat.
